description.decoded:
[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone

objectives.decoded: {sc}Go to the City of Torc'qua and destroy Lord Jadoth.{sc}Go to Ravenheart Gloom and destroy the Greater Darkness.{sc}Go to the Foundry of Failed Creations and destroy the Fury.{sc}Go to the Stygian Veil and destroy the Dreadspawn Maw.{sc}Report your success in defeating the Lords of Anguish to High Priest Zhellix.{s}Speak to High Priest Zhellix to commence the assault on the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx the Unyielding.

description.decoded:
We Norn have a saying: "Strength is life, but strength counts for nothing without wisdom." A darting rabbit can render the hawk's strength useless. But the raven understands the power of patience and the virtue of foresight. The raven scans the world around it, constantly seeking its next meal, never knowing if food will appear in the light of day or deep amongst the shadows. The raven represents knowledge, the ultimate skill of the patient hunter. If you seek to prove your skills as a hunter, head to Raven's Point.

I hear Raven's voice on the wind; he speaks of a creature hiding in the shadows. But beware, this beast cannot be felled by strength alone. You will need the patience of Raven to meet this challenge, unless you wish to dart through the shadows like a scared, little rabbit. Do this and I shall grant you the Raven Blessing. Reward:100 Norn reputation pointsRaven BlessingLockpick

objectives.decoded: {s}Travel to Raven's Point to begin the hunt.

description.decoded:
Cmon Meow. Excellent. I have another task for your attention. With the defeat the Charr have suffered here, some have begun pulling their forces back. Because of this, one of my scouts saw the Charr moving another group of <c=@Quest>prisoners</c>. They are currently being held in a cave in the <c=@Quest>Dalada Uplands</c>. I'm certain this is only transitional and if we wait too long, the Charr will move the prisoners to a more defensible gulag. This may be our best chance to save them. Get to it before the prisoners are chow.

Reward:<brx>100 Vanguard reputation points<brx>Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Locate the cave where the captives are being held in the Dalada Uplands.

description.decoded:
<c=@Quest>Hayda</c> was looking for you, Cmon Meow. She went ahead into <c=@Quest>Sparkfly Swamp</c>, and asked that you meet her there. It's rare to see her this motivated, so I can only assume that it's something important. You'll need to speak with her to ascertain the details.

Reward:<brx>10,000 Experience<brx>Hayda joins your party.<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Meet Hayda in Sparkfly Swamp.

description.decoded:
<c=@warning>[Difficulty: Elite]</c> I have many stories. This unfortunate tale began only a few weeks ago. My brothers received word that the last of the Stone Summit hierophants has gathered a force of enslaved creatures. One of his slaves chafes enough at his collar to risk a message to his master's enemies and has told us that Hierophant Duncan seeks to harness the power of the recently defeated Great Destroyer's soul. My brothers rejoiced at these tidings, resolving to wait until the hierophant completed his ritual so they may stage a glorious battle. You may say it's not very Norn of me, but it might be wise for someone to confront Duncan the Black before he has the chance to harness the dead Destroyer's power.

Reward:<brx>15,000 Experience<brx>2,750 Gold<brx>

objectives.decoded: {sc}Defeat Justiciar Thommis{sc}Defeat Rand Stormweaver{sc}Defeat Selvetarm{sc}Defeat Forgewight{s}Destroy Duncan the Black

description.decoded:
[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone

Flashback Quest: While this quest is in your Quest Log, the lands of Cantha will revisit the time of the Afflicted.

Greetings, citizen! Have you heard the news? Thanks to the tireless efforts of Cantha's people, led by the Ministry of Purity, the plague that has cursed our great nation has finally been driven out.

Allow me to share with you the story of these struggles, that we may honor the sacrifices of those who have fallen in this noble task.

description.decoded:
The forest to the north has long been allied with neither Balthazar nor Menzies. The God of War has allowed this neutrality so long as the Wailing Lord has not interfered with our forces. Of late, the Wailing Lord has protested our forays to gather timber and stone for the Temple of War. Workers and messengers have been attacked.

Go into the forest and destroy the banshees that serve the master of the forest, but do not harm the Wailing Lord himself. Our purpose is to instruct, not to destroy. Reward:10,000 Experience

objectives.decoded: {s}Destroy the forest banshees. You have 5 more forest banshees left.{s}Do not harm the Wailing Lord.

Greetings, citizen! Have you heard the news? Thanks to the tireless efforts of Cantha's people, led by the Ministry of Purity, the plague that has cursed our great nation has finally been driven out.

Allow me to share with you the story of these struggles, that we may honor the sacrifices of those who have fallen in this noble task.

objectives.decoded: {s}Relive the events of the Canthan plague.

name:
The forest to the north has long been allied with neither Balthazar nor Menzies. The God of War has allowed this neutrality so long as the Wailing Lord has not interfered with our forces. Of late, the Wailing Lord has protested our forays to gather timber and stone for the Temple of War. Workers and messengers have been attacked.

Go into the forest and destroy the banshees that serve the master of the forest, but do not harm the Wailing Lord himself. Our purpose is to instruct, not to destroy. Reward:10,000 Experience
{s}Destroy the forest banshees. You have 5 more forest banshees left.{s}Do not harm the Wailing Lord.

description.decoded:
[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone

objectives.decoded: {s}Go to the City of Torc'qua and destroy Lord Jadoth.{s}Go to Ravenheart Gloom and destroy the Greater Darkness.{s}Go to the Foundry of Failed Creations and destroy the Fury.{s}Go to the Stygian Veil and destroy the Dreadspawn Maw.

Menzies, Lord of Destruction, will not rest while we hold the Temple of War. There can be no doubt he will launch a new attack very soon. Balthazar will send new Temple Guards shortly. In the meantime, will you remain and fight off the next wave of <c=@Quest>Shadow Army Invaders</c>?

Reward:<brx>10,000 Experience<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Destroy the Shadow Army Invader. You have 7 groups left.{s}The Crafter must survive.

description.decoded:
[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone

description.decoded:
Flashback Quest: While this quest is in your Quest Log, the lands of Cantha will revisit the time of the Afflicted.

Greetings, citizen! Have you heard the news? Thanks to the tireless efforts of Cantha's people, led by the Ministry of Purity, the plague that has cursed our great nation has finally been driven out.

Allow me to share with you the story of these struggles, that we may honor the sacrifices of those who have fallen in this noble task.

description.decoded:
Here at the heart of the Temple of War are forged the very arms and armor of the gods. This most sacred of places has been defiled. During the brief period while the vile Shadow Army of Menzies usurped the Temple, they choked the pure fires of the forge with a vile miasma used to imbue all their weapons with an unholy taint.

Though they have been driven from the Temple, the source of this corruption remains in the tunnel that feeds the forge. Go to tunnel and purge it of all seeds of corruption. Reward:10,000 Experience

objectives.decoded: {s}Destroy the seeds of corruption. You have 5 seeds of corruption left.

description.decoded:
It was through treachery, not force of arms, that Menzies waylaid the true protectors of the temple and imprisoned me. Imagining some greater glory he might attain, the scheming Lord Khobay, head of the Temple Guard, betrayed us and delivered the Temple into the hands of the Shadow Army.

Seeing your approach, the coward fled, no doubt seeking to hide in the Lake of Fire. Go now and deliver justice to Lord Khobay and all of the traitorous Temple Guards. Reward:10,000 Experience

objectives.decoded: {s}Strike down Lord Khobay.

It was through treachery, not force of arms, that Menzies waylaid the true protectors of the temple and imprisoned me. Imagining some greater glory he might attain, the scheming Lord Khobay, head of the Temple Guard, betrayed us and delivered the Temple into the hands of the Shadow Army.

Seeing your approach, the coward fled, no doubt seeking to hide in the Lake of Fire. Go now and deliver justice to Lord Khobay and all of the traitorous Temple Guards. Reward:10,000 Experience

description.decoded:
Here at the heart of the Temple of War are forged the very arms and armor of the gods. This most sacred of places has been defiled. During the brief period while the vile Shadow Army of Menzies usurped the Temple, they choked the pure fires of the forge with a vile miasma used to imbue all their weapons with an unholy taint.

Though they have been driven from the Temple, the source of this corruption remains in the tunnel that feeds the forge. Go to tunnel and purge it of all seeds of corruption. Reward:10,000 Experience

objectives.decoded: {s}Destroy the seeds of corruption. You have 5 seeds of corruption left.

objectives.decoded: {s}Strike down Lord Khobay.

description.decoded:
[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone

description.decoded:
Flashback Quest: While this quest is in your Quest Log, the lands of Cantha will revisit the time of the Afflicted.

Greetings, citizen! Have you heard the news? Thanks to the tireless efforts of Cantha's people, led by the Ministry of Purity, the plague that has cursed our great nation has finally been driven out.

Allow me to share with you the story of these struggles, that we may honor the sacrifices of those who have fallen in this noble task.
